rule: FROZEN before any model or the promotion code sees it; hash this file (sha256 in the commit message and the receipt) and never edit it. Wording differs from cards_dev.json and held-out v1, v2 and v3. 18 card-worthy (4 checklist, 4 comparison, 4 timeline, 3 facts, 3 mixed), 9 plain, 9 near-miss (3 prose requests, 2 short lists, 2 code-only, 2 explanations likely to use headed sections). Thresholds fixed now: >= 15 of 18 card-worthy produce a valid card, 0 cards on the 18 plain and near-miss prompts from either the model fence or promotion, every card passes validate_components.
